pr_title: Fix crash in Missle that tries to sqrt number < 0
pr_comments:
Can you please explain the logic behind the fix here?
Its not clear from the diff why these heights can only now be greater than 2 * loopRadius or why setting these to 0 is the correct fix.

> Its not clear from the diff why these heights can only now be greater than 2 * loopRadius or why setting these to 0 is the correct fix.

As for "why these heights can only now be greater than 2 * loop radius", I don't know either on the original method they used. The fix I done here is only a <0 detection to avoid game crash on height < 2 * loop radius (although it is rare, it does crash) 

Better idea is welcomed and in needed.
This branch is abandoned long time and missile also has other bugs on isometric map. I think rework missile can be a better way.
Sure, we still don't officially support isometric mods so it might be fine to wait for a proper fix

issue_context.title: Crash related with missile climbs higher terrain
issue_context.body:
## System Information

- Operating System:  widows 10 
- MissileTA.cs modified from Missile.cs from release version last year, but crash related place was not modified since then.

## Exception log


## Additional information

The crash is due to `2 * loopRadius - h1` < 0, as you can see at picture below.

comments: Looks like an overflow issue, which means we probably need to use `long`s there?

I guess not? When crash happens h1=1823, loopRadius=418, and 

2 * loopRadius - h1 = -987

h1 *  (-987) = -1,799,301

it is not an overflow.

(and Int32min should be  -2147483648, which is much larger in abs)

Then never mind me I guess. Can you propose a fix? The comment says the height needs to be found once the missile is one loop radius away, which means we probably shouldn't even use this code path when it's more than twice the radius away in distance?

For fix, I can only put a Math.abs here but I don't know if it is correct. 

>which means we probably shouldn't even use this code path when it's more than twice the radius away in distance?

Yep, but I cannot find better idea on that.
Can you please provide a minimal repro case for this in TS?
I am unable to reproduce this bug for I don't even know which missile trigger this crash in map and the gameplay lasts one hour, which is a shame.
I can only find out the cause and use exception to get var value in this case

review_comments:
perhaps
```suggestion
							+ Exts.ISqrt(Math.Abs(predAttHght * (2 * loopRadius - predAttHght))))); // Target too close to hit at current speed
```

idk if we should use an absolute number here, also I don't know how to produce an usecase to test this function properly(loop radius and other parameters are too substract). All I know is, iosmeric map with height will have a tiny chance crash on it.
as I mentioned we could use Math.Max(variable, 0) instead
Tomorrow I will take a look at it. I think I should make a comment here about the future missile test.
